The corresponding git-svn commit is 891791d1dff102d4f75d5647e3e725f51b5e615c (#12154 - clean up translations), which removed the ISO 21090 String/ST narrative, disabled ST-translation and ST-language in the ISO 21090 spreadsheet, and added ST.translation to the newer translation extension mapping.

The built Multi-Language Support page links to the translation extension and shows lang/content pairs for multiple translations. The translation extension source of truth is now in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-translation.xml, where the canonical URL and ST.translation RIM mapping are present. A 2020 Zulip implementer thread also identifies iso21090-st-translation as the old way and points users to the current translation extension.
